title: Man Refuses To Leave His Brother's House, Police Drag Him Out
description:
Being a homeowner comes with its own fair share of challenges but what happens when your own brother becomes an unwanted guest? As soon as the officers entered the residence, the suspect locked himself in a room and started yelling that he lives in this house. The officers barged in through the door in an attempt to detain the male who began resisting ferociously. It took 3 officers to drag him out. Soon, their mother also arrived on the scene and shed light on the family relationship. The 24-year-old male was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting arrest with violence and trespassing.
